Body.Content:
What and Why:

Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac will support organization skills that admins can upload and share across their tenant. This replaces the earlier “tenant-wide shareable skills” wording with Organization skill support for Copilot in PowerPoint.

This update helps organizations scale approved Copilot skills in PowerPoint with centralized admin management, supporting a more consistent and governed Copilot experience for users.

Rollout Schedule:

  • General Availability, Worldwide: We will begin rolling out in early September 2026 and expect to complete by late September 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Microsoft 365 admins who manage Copilot experiences and organization skills.
  • Users with Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac.
  • Users who access organization-provided Copilot skills in PowerPoint.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot.
  • PowerPoint for Mac.
  • Microsoft 365 admin center.

What will happen:

  • Admins will be able to upload organization skills in the Microsoft 365 admin center using the appropriate schema.
  • Admins can share approved organization skills so they appear in Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac.
  • Users can access organization-provided Copilot skills within PowerPoint when those skills are made available by admins.
  • This feature supports centralized governance and distribution of Copilot skills across the organization.
  • The related support article for organization skill support in Copilot in PowerPoint is being prepared by the feature team.

Action Required/Recommendations:

  • No action is required before rollout unless your organization plans to publish organization skills for PowerPoint.
  • Review your organization’s governance process for Copilot skills.
  • Identify which organization skills should be shared broadly across your tenant.
  • Prepare admins who manage Microsoft 365 Copilot to upload skills in the Microsoft 365 admin center using the required schema.
  • Update internal Copilot or PowerPoint guidance if your organization documents how users access approved organization skills.

Compliance considerations:

Does the change introduce or significantly modify AI/ML or agent capabilities that interact with or provide access to customer data?Yes. Organization skills can extend Copilot in PowerPoint experiences that interact with user prompts and organizational data available to Copilot.
Does the change provide end users any new way of interacting with generative AI?Yes. Users can access organization-provided Copilot skills in PowerPoint when admins make those skills available.
Does the change alter how admins can monitor, report on, or demonstrate compliance activities?Yes. Admins can centrally manage and distribute organization skills through the Microsoft 365 admin center, supporting governance of available Copilot skills.
Does the change include an admin control and, can it be controlled through Entra ID group membership?Yes. Admins can upload and manage organization skills in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The request does not state whether this can be scoped through Entra ID group membership.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac will support organization skills that admins can upload and share tenant-wide via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling centralized governance and consistent user experiences. Rollout begins September 2026, with no immediate action required unless publishing skills.
